item.title: Tech outages and NSA network disruption fuel broad market sell-off
item.description: Stocks fell sharply Tuesday, with the Dow Jones Industrial Average dropping 766 points, or 1.5%, as a series of technology outages and a reported disruption to a classified U.S. national security communications network added to investor jitters ahead of Nvidia's earnings report. item.title: Nvidia set to report first earnings since CEO ouster as stock plunges
item.description: Nvidia is set to report quarterly results after the close Tuesday in what may be the most anticipated earnings announcement in the chipmaker's 33-year history, landing less than a week after co-founder Jensen Huang's abrupt resignation as CEO. item.title: FDA approves Roche's breast cancer pill Wilserdly (giredestrant) for advanced ESR1-mutated disease
item.description: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration on Monday approved Roche's oral breast cancer drug giredestrant, to be marketed as Wilserdly, for a specific subset of patients with advanced disease, teeing up the launch of a medicine the Swiss company has said could become its top-selling product ever.
